name: hecigo-ads-insights
description: Advertising reporting across Meta Ads, Google Ads and TikTok Ads through hecigo's hosted MCP server, reading by default: performance with conversion value and ROAS, campaign settings and real targets, search terms, Performance Max and Facebook Page insights. Budget changes exist only in a workspace given the write scope, through a plan you approve. Includes skills for a weekly report, ROAS against target, search term clean-up, a Performance Max audit, a Meta cost diagnosis for sellers in Vietnam and safe budget changes.
